description: Land Acquisition - Amendment to the Extra Gazette No. 2222/63 dated 9th April 2021 - D/S Division Kahawatta
reasoning: This gazette content is a notice under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically amending dates for examination of title and handover of documents related to land acquisition. It deals with land acquisition procedures, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
